name: Bible Keep
description: Google Keep-style note-taking app with Bible verse insertion. Create text notes, auto-detect verse references (e.g. 'matt 5:12'), and fetch verses from API.Bible in NLT translation.
author: linuxbox
changelog: Initial release on VibeStore. Note creation, auto verse detection, API.Bible integration.

name: Watch Battery
description: Monitor your Bluetooth watch battery level from your phone. Connects via BLE, shows battery percentage, and sends low-battery notifications so you're never caught with a dead watch.
author: linuxbox
changelog: Initial release on VibeStore. BLE watch battery monitoring with low-battery notifications.

author: linuxbox
